final_message:
Completed the standard-depth strategy build. The one-line query is in [final_strategy.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-def605b9b5df8f15/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T110601Z/final_strategy.txt); the [audit](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-def605b9b5df8f15/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T110601Z/work/audit.md) includes the line-by-line counts, rationale, screening notes, and critic dispositions.

The final search returned **822 records**, with the publication date capped at 2019-02-22. It retrieved all nine records in the development set (100% relative recall), but that set was used to build the strategy; independent recall was not estimated. The audit records the assumption that farm animals means terrestrial livestock and poultry, excluding aquaculture. The draft still needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist.
